comment: Empty by design (ARIA-V5 §3e Phase 2 — permanent enforcement). Every agent file pedagogy_lint scans carries its V5 §3e narrative pairings, so the C4 grandfather entries are removed. pedagogy_lint runs --strict in CI (the aria-kernel.yml "Run pedagogy lint" step) and in the V5.3 invariant, which IGNORES this allowlist — a new un-narrated imperative reds the gate regardless of any entry added here. Do not re-add grandfather entries; narrate the agent (a **Why:**/**Consequence:**/**Example:** within 6 lines below the imperative) instead.
